variables.pause: {{ is_state('alarm_control_panel.home', 'armed_away') and (now().timestamp() - (state_attr('input_datetime.climate_away_since', 'timestamp') | float(0))) > 21600 and is_state('water_heater.hot_water_hot_water', 'auto') and not is_state('input_boolean.house_hot_water_paused', 'on') }}
variables.restore: {% set d = states('sensor.home_nearest_distance') %}{{ is_state('input_boolean.house_hot_water_paused', 'on') and (not is_state('alarm_control_panel.home', 'armed_away') or is_state('input_boolean.climate_arrival_preheat', 'on') or (is_number(d) and d | float < 15000 and is_state('sensor.home_nearest_direction_of_travel', 'towards'))) }}

alias: House — hot water off while away
description: Operator 2026-11-24: after 6 h of Away the Tado hot water (only if it runs its schedule, 'auto') is switched off and input_boolean.house_hot_water_paused remembers that HA did it. Restored to 'auto' when the alarm leaves Away, the arrival pre-heat starts, or someone heads home within 15 km. Off for more than 48 h: two hours at 65 C first (reheat from cold plus an hour at 60 C or more; review 2026-11-26, tests/climate/wiring.py), then 'auto'. A tank set by hand is never touched. Docs: docs/hot-water.md.
